How we rebuilt the reading room

By the facilities team

After forty years of service, the reading room needed new lighting, quieter heating and step-free access from the street entrance.

What changed

  • Daylight-balanced lamps on every table
  • A ramp and automatic doors at the east entrance

The work took eleven months and the room stayed open for most of it.Tracking pixel text

It finally feels like a room you want to stay in.

A regular visitor
